item.title: October Lantern 0.6.21
item.description:
• Report a Problem sends straight away. One click sends Lantern's logs (without passwords or keys) and copies the code for you to share. An email opens only if sending fails; on Mac you can still add details by email afterwards.
  • Tables in replies read properly. A table shows as its header, then one line per row, instead of raw | and ---.
  • Tasks Ask hands to a running agent ask you first. When Ask passes your request to an agent that's already running, the agent asks you to decide things like what to delete or move, with a question card, instead of only listing what it found.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
